growth_scenarios.note: Physical signed net change includes all occupants and deletions on each filesystem; logical bucket cache bytes represent versions and are not additive with the same volume. Cache update is not proof of a complete scan. Each rate is a short-window linear scenario only.

retention_capacity.required_horizon_days: 7 + unknown wait until first complete provider snapshot readback; may be extended by late-arrival rules
retention_capacity.quota_scenario_formula: quota >= current logical versions + logical net growth/day * (7 + snapshot_wait_days) + concurrent logical overhead; subject to validated version accounting
retention_capacity.source_volume_scenario_formula: available - required_source_gate >= whole-volume physical net growth/day * (7 + snapshot_wait_days) + independent future transient peak, including unknown additional restore peak beyond 512 MiB; do not add bucket or database growth already included in whole-volume growth
retention_capacity.archive_volume_scenario_formula: available - applicable archive gate >= whole-volume archive physical net growth/day * (7 + snapshot_wait_days) + independent future transient peak

backlog.formula: drain_days = backlog_bytes / (throughput_bytes_per_day - inflow_bytes_per_day), only if throughput > inflow; positive backlog cannot drain at zero/negative net rate
backlog.separate_constraints: Throughput is not inferred from readback or quota. Ensure capacity during draining and throughout snapshot wait + seven days; historical deletion requires separate evidence and approval.

blockers: Fresh Direct version scans did not complete: request timeout, then Source host memory below the unchanged 704 MiB floor.
Gateway cache decoding did not pass; full bucket/cache/spool coverage remains unproven.
Restore attempts stopped before PostgreSQL creation: admission load, then the crypto-helper host-health guard. Administrative wait correction therefore has no native readiness/COPY acceptance.
No stable conservative startup window: none of ten samples provided three consecutive qualifying observations.
Full restore PGDATA/WAL/index/temporary-file peak and all planned active-operation windows remain unproven.
Sustainable archive net throughput, exact backlog and time until the first complete matching snapshot are unmeasured.
Short-window whole-volume growth scenarios do not establish the required seven-day reserve. Archive headroom above its Science gate is small.
no_double_counting: Database, WAL, buckets and observed directories already occupy their filesystems. Logical cache growth is not additive with whole-volume growth.
